summary: Social preview image (og:image) blank on X/socials — no og:image or twitter:card tags on any guru-ai.org page
description:
Reported by owner: sharing a guru-ai.org chapter link on X shows a card with the
correct title + description but a BLANK placeholder image (generic card icon).
See the Kybalion Ch IX share on @lookslikeprimes, 2026-08-19.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed live against prod as Twitterbot):
No page on the site emits an og:image, and there is no twitter:card tag anywhere.
- `curl -A Twitterbot https://guru-ai.org` returns ONLY <meta name="description"> —
  zero og:* and zero twitter:* tags.
- Chapter route src/app/read/[tradition]/[textId]/[n]/page.tsx sets
  openGraph:{ type, title } with NO `images` field. That is why X still renders
  title/description but leaves the image slot blank.
- No `openGraph.images` anywhere in src/app; no `twitter` block anywhere.
- No public/ directory exists (no static asset to point at); no dynamic
  opengraph-image.tsx / next/og route either.

Two separate deficiencies, both needed for a good card:
1. Missing og:image  -> blank image slot (the reported symptom).
2. Missing twitter:card=summary_large_image -> even once an image exists, X uses
   the small square "summary" layout instead of the large banner card.

PROPOSED FIX (compose A now, layer B later):
A. Quick / global floor (~15 min): add a static public/og.png (1200x630) plus a
   default openGraph.images + twitter { card:'summary_large_image', ... } block to
   the root metadata in src/app/layout.tsx. Every page inherits it, turning every
   shared link from blank-placeholder into a real card.
B. On-brand / per-page (dynamic): add opengraph-image.tsx on the read routes using
   next/og ImageResponse to render chapter title + tradition + a procedural motif
   per URL. Stronger for a research site where each shared link is a different
   passage. More work; do after A.

VERIFY: re-fetch as Twitterbot and confirm og:image + twitter:card present; run the
URL through X's Card Validator / a real share once deployed. metadataBase is already
set in root layout so image URLs resolve absolute — good.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Spec A ('default openGraph.images in root layout') is incomplete: Next.js shallow-merges metadata, so any page exporting its own openGraph fully REPLACES the root openGraph (images lost). Audited src/app: exactly ONE page overrides openGraph — the chapter route read/[tradition]/[textId]/[n]/page.tsx (the shared surface in the report) — and ZERO pages override twitter. Corrected fix: (1) root layout gets openGraph.images + a twitter block {card:'summary_large_image', images:['/og.png']}; twitter cascades to every route (none override it) and X reads twitter:image preferentially, so this alone fixes the reported X blank-card everywhere. (2) Also add images:[OG_IMAGE] to the chapter page's own openGraph so og:image (FB/Discord/Slack path) is present there too. Static asset public/og.png (1200x630, on-brand) generated via sharp.

resolution.note: Proposal A implemented: static public/og.png (1200x630, on-brand serif wordmark + geometric sigil) + SOCIAL_METADATA in @/lib/site spread into root metadata (og:image, og:title/desc/url, twitter card=summary_large_image + image). twitter cascades to all routes (none override it) and X prefers twitter:image, so the reported X blank-card is fixed sitewide incl. chapter pages; chapter reader also re-attaches OG_IMAGE to its own openGraph for the og:image (FB/Discord/Slack) path. Proposal B (per-page dynamic next/og images on read routes) intentionally deferred as follow-up.
